truth_boundary: Proof entries are conservative portfolio baselines. Project-wide stage must not inherit proof from a narrower provider route without an explicit scope note.

projects.name: EvidenceOps Capital Intelligence OS
notes: Merged implementation includes durable persistence, bounded HTTP runtime, transaction decision logic, evidence vault, end-to-end synthetic acquisition journey and provider qualification/canary contracts.
Provider production execution/readback remains a separate proof gate; source or canary readiness is not deployment.

projects.name: EvidenceOps eCertify ZA
notes: Merged source includes private/public service boundaries, signed receipt verification, replay protection, provider adapters, legal evidence gates, document-security gates and Launch-Now browser hashing flow.
A live deployed Track A user journey remains to be independently proven.

projects.name: CASEFORGE-Ω / SCIENTIA

A real provider execution plus independent provider/model readback is deliberately still open.

projects.name: In-Place Evidence Processing / Audio Evidence v4
notes: The current workspace has real processed units, indexed segments, provenance/custody controls and searchable outputs.
The next portfolio jump is a clean callable service with upload/ingest, queue, transcription, indexing, retrieval and observability.

projects.name: ARCHITRON / Kim Dataverse Automation Plane

Cloud Run/WIF and action-specific semantic dispatch must not inherit this provider-verified scope until separately proven.
